clues.description: A synthetic olive-green fiber, snagged on a splinter near the scene. It matches the carpet rolls sold at Ernesto's shop.
A crumpled invoice with near-zero sales and a note showing heavy financial debt to Robert Hale.
He claimed he was in his shop all night, but his truck was seen cruising the dark highway shoulder at midnight.
A fresh cut on his palm, poorly bandaged. He claims it was a shop tool, but it matches jagged bottle glass.
The loose chain lies on the ground, the padlock burst outward using a boiler wrench. Someone broke out, not in.
According to Elena, only Robert Hale holds the key to the boiler room. Nobody else is allowed down there.
Mark talks about noises and someone locked away. Frank mentions Robert constantly hauling heavy boxes to the basement.
He reached the crime scene in under ninety seconds, fully dressed in suit and fine dress shoes at midnight.
The Old Crow gin label matches the exact bottle Mark bought at the gas station that evening.
The fatal shard used in the attack matches the jagged neck of Mark's shattered gin bottle.

clues.displayName: Frank saw Mark cross paths with Carla
clues.description: Frank saw Mark and Carla arguing or crossing paths near the roadside shortly before midnight.
His story breaks into panic and confusion after seeing a tall figure in clean clothes step out from the dark.
Witnesses saw her fleeing the alleyway right after the scream, visibly terrified and furious.
She carries a master pass to every motel door and hallway, allowing unmonitored movement across the complex.

clues.displayName: Carla's travel bag and escape cash
clues.description: Carla's hidden bag. Contains a single bus ticket to Seattle and $5,000 cash stolen from the escape pact with Elena.
Elena discovered Carla's betrayal and violently screamed at her before midnight: 'You won't leave with my money!'
